mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the best way of ensuring that each site is easily recognized."
Good photographic documentation is the best way of ensuring that each site is easily recognized.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a device used to test the concentration of a solution by measuring its absorbance of a specific wavelength of light."
Colorimeter is a device used to test the concentration of a solution by measuring its absorbance of a specific wavelength of light.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an essential activity within the scope of Environmental Science."
Biological study is an essential activity within the scope of Environmental Science.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the scientific study of the distribution and abundance of life and the interactions between organisms and their natural environment."
Ecology is the scientific study of the distribution and abundance of life and the interactions between organisms and their natural environment.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the collective term for a family of laboratory techniques for the separation of mixtures."
Chromatography is the collective term for a family of laboratory techniques for the separation of mixtures.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a measurement of the dissolved material in an aqueous solution, which relates to the ability of the material to conduct electrical current through it."
Electrical conductivity (EC) is a measurement of the dissolved material in an aqueous solution, which relates to the ability of the material to conduct electrical current through it.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a group of individuals' persons, objects, or items from which samples are taken for measurement."
A population is a group of individuals' persons, objects, or items from which samples are taken for measurement.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an instrument used to measure the amount of solar radiation (power) the sun produces in a specific location."
A pyranometer is an instrument used to measure the amount of solar radiation (power) the sun produces in a specific location.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the horizontal and oblique tows in which various strata of the lake are sampled individually (a horizontal tow) or as a composite (oblique tow)."
Alternatives to the vertical tow are the horizontal and oblique tows in which various strata of the lake are sampled individually (a horizontal tow) or as a composite (oblique tow).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the less obvious sampling error against which nature offers very little protection."
The more dangerous error is the less obvious sampling error against which nature offers very little protection.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an evacuated glass test tube shaped vessel, capped with a self - sealing butyl rubber spectrum."
The vacutainer system is an evacuated glass test tube shaped vessel, capped with a self - sealing butyl rubber spectrum.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an optical instrument used to measure properties of light over a specific portion of the electromagnetic spectrum, typically used in spectroscopic analysis to identify materials."
A spectrometer is an optical instrument used to measure properties of light over a specific portion of the electromagnetic spectrum, typically used in spectroscopic analysis to identify materials.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a tendency to favour the selection of units that have paticular characteristics."
Sampling bias is a tendency to favour the selection of units that have paticular characteristics.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an important element in ecology, because statistics are widely used to process the results of sampling."
True randomness is an important element in ecology, because statistics are widely used to process the results of sampling.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the keyword in research; a biased investigation has no home in scientific world."
Objectivity is the keyword in research; a biased investigation has no home in scientific world.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used gases that are more difficult to collect, and fine porosity frits are used for highly volatile gaseous substances that are extremely difficult to collect."
Medium porosity frits are used gases that are more difficult to collect, and fine porosity frits are used for highly volatile gaseous substances that are extremely difficult to collect.

Meteorology

technique
technique is the use of a single portable analytical instrument to analyse multiple samples on site (where they are collected).
